finding: Floating/split link previews had no local find UI or shortcut owner. Added per-preview find state with document/source/web adapters. Native guest follow-up searches stalled at the last match; restart the native directional session at boundaries or zero matches.

upstream.adopted: Ctrl/Cmd+F, Enter/F3 directions, local result state, 20px actions and 4px padding; existing 26px preview toolbar.
upstream.electron: 42.2.0 electron_api_web_contents.cc FindInPage maps findNext to new_session.

baseline.symptom: Preview search entry absent before implementation.

intermediate_failures.reason: Stale active flag captured main-editor Ctrl+F; route now checks actual focus.
Native button and F3 wrap returned no result; boundary restart verified with native counts and scroll.
Private test run did not produce checks; stopped only its private-copy processes and repeated sequentially. No pass claimed.

core.scope: Complete npm run check. Final source match-limit adjustment additionally verified in the focused UI and final native candidate.

ui.scope: Trusted Chromium Ctrl+F/F3/Enter/Escape; editor/two-preview focus isolation; inline text and Chinese; 20/100/1000 Markdown matches and 1000 source matches beyond Monaco default 999; stale queries, cleanup, 170/240/320px find-row geometry, light/dark variables and screenshots.

latency.event: DOM input event to result text plus next animation frame
latency.limits: Observed isolated fixture values, not physical typing latency or a performance guarantee for arbitrary documents.

native.scope: Trusted Chromium guest Ctrl+F/F3/Shift+F3/Escape; native counts and scroll, forward/reverse wrap, Chinese, no results and repeat, navigation/reload, 20 find lifecycles, local highlights and cleanup, page Node/host bridge denial and synthetic key rejection.

install_uninstall.scope: Same final candidate standard install/check/restore-uninstall/reinstall/check/detach-uninstall/reinstall/check; startup modes 0/1/2/3 and custom folder retained; failure/cancel/rollback assertions.

local.uninstall: Read-only preflight only in user environment

limits: No physical OS keyboard automation, other-platform or full application UI acceptance.
Web pages containing focused nested cross-origin frames were not tested for keyboard forwarding. Restricted iframe fallback hosts explicitly report unavailable web find.
Native screenshots use the light host theme; dark find-row variables and geometry were tested in Chromium, not all four native themes.
Existing R067.7 original field sequence, R071.7/R068.11/R005.4, language-fence return, PPT preview stalls and signed modern shell delivery remain open.
